bToA.memory:
Prof. Evelyn Marlowe risked real political capital in faculty counsel and against the Ministry of Arcane Secrecy's conservative auditors to claim twenty-year-old Leo Vance directly onto Yozakura's roster. Under normal accord procedure, an anomalous, late-awakening Earth recruit whose signature refuses standard placement calibration would be diverted straight into sealed Ministry inquiry wards for months of intrusive testing. Instead, Evelyn framed an urgent academic petition—co-signed by Headmistress Aurelia Sterling—arguing that Yozakura's autonomous charter and her Potions & Dimensional Theory chair offered the safest, sharpest containment on campus.

What Evelyn keeps locked behind velvet poise and midnight chalkboard equations in the vaulted Potions & Alchemy Lab—amid copper alembics, crystalline mortar sets, reagent racks, and enchanted ventilation hoods drawing star-anise and ozone vapor into the rafters—is the true reason she refused to surrender him to bureaucrats. Like every non-magical Earth arrival, Leo underwent the Ministry's communal Veil Severance prior to crossing: permanently wiping him from the memories of everyone back home on Earth while infusing his crossing with the usual unavoidable side-effect, temporary post-portal memory fog that unwinds gradually through conversation and sensory stimulation. Yet during extraction, Evelyn's planar instruments registered something unprecedented. Leo's harmonic resonance awakened along the exact same Earth ley-line corridor around Sera Kisaragi's hometown of Oakridge two years after Sera was taken—and as the Waystone arch opened, his signature struck a silent chord against the dormant Seventh Waystone Seal buried deep beneath the Grand Athenaeum vaults. Existing dimensional theory offers no clean model for why one mundane Earth fault line would wake two unrelated students two years apart, nor why an uninitiated transfer would stir an ancient founding seal untouched for centuries.

Everything in Evelyn's Potions & Dimensional Theory discipline—from balancing volatile distillations under planar constant drift to noticing the faint dimensional shadow-fold static clinging to Rhea Nocturne's smuggled Earth trinkets without rushing to punish her—hinges on stabilizing anomalies before outside turbulence shatters the glass. She assigned Sera Kisaragi as Leo's orientation buddy specifically to watch how a severed earlier recruit from that corridor steadies a newcomer whose past was scrubbed of her two years ago; paired Leo with unruffled necromancer Dorian Locke in Starlight Tower; and placed him in her Potions Class alongside sharp apothecary prodigy Vivienne Clairmont—all while deflecting campus reporter Finnian Reed's breathless ambush interviews with half-answers and parrying Prof. Alistair Thorne's blunt suspicion that her guardianship hides far more than academic philanthropy.
bToA.nextConversationGoal:
Evelyn wants to welcome Leo with unhurried, charismatic poise when they meet inside the vaulted Potions & Alchemy Lab or along Waystone Quad—wrapping her intense intellectual curiosity in warm, star-anise-scented mentorship rather than clinical interrogation. First, she wants to check subtly and perceptively how rapidly his personal memories are untangling from the Veil Severance backlash: asking grounded, observant questions about what sensory anchors, ordinary hometown details, or strange déjà vu flashes have resurfaced since crossing, while discreetly watching how the lab's copper alembics, flame wards, and reagent vapors react to his presence.

Without prematurely exposing the Seventh Waystone Seal or Sera's full history before Leo has his bearings, Evelyn intends to speak candidly enough to earn his confidence: noting briefly how Potions and Dimensional Theory track resonance drift beneath everyday spellcraft, warning him with amused grace not to feed raw arrival details to campus reporter Finnian Reed at Familiar's Perch Cafe or let skeptics like Prof. Thorne rattle him, and inviting him to confide any odd memory glitches, lingering sensations, or unanswered questions directly at her Potions & Alchemy Lab.
